SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT CLASS_1, CLASS_2,CLASS_3,CLASS_4,CLASS_5 FROM UCUBE.XOIF_CATEGORY WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N'
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'HSDE' AS BUYER ,'KA' AS SITE ,SEQ ,CLASS_1 ,CLASS_2 ,CLASS_3 ,CLASS_4 ,CLASS_5 ,CLASS_1_DESC ,CLASS_2_DESC ,CLASS_3_DESC ,CLASS_4_DESC ,CLASS_5_DESC FROM UCUBE.XOIF_CATEGORY WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N'
UPDATE UCUBE.XOIF_CATEGORY SET IF_FLAG = 'Y', IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND CLASS_1 = $G_RS.CLASS_1$ AND CLASS_2 = $G_RS.CLASS_2$ AND CLASS_3 = $G_RS.CLASS_3$ AND CLASS_4 = $G_RS.CLASS_4$ AND CLASS_5 = $G_RS.CLASS_5$
